user.title: Add a PC
user.description: Connect to a PC running the PC Power agent. The token is printed by the agent's install.sh and stored in /etc/pc-power/config.toml.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found the PC Power agent on {name} ({host}). Enter its token to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the agent. Is it running and is the port open?

abort.not_supported: This agent did not advertise a machine ID.

init.title: Power estimate
init.description: PC power = (CPU + GPU + disks + controller + fans & pump + RGB + board + USB devices) ÷ PSU efficiency. Monitors are estimated separately (wall-powered). Detected disks: {hdd} HDD, {ssd} SATA SSD, {nvme} NVMe.

data.fans_w: Fans & AIO pump at full speed (W)
data.fans_dynamic: Scale fan power with measured fan speed
data.rgb_w: RGB on fan/RAM/strip headers (W) — not GPU RGB, that's in the GPU reading
data.offline_w: PC power when off or asleep (W at the wall, excluding monitors)
data.grace_polls: Failed polls before treating the PC as off

data_description.fans_dynamic: Uses motherboard fan RPM (power ≈ speed³) against the highest speed seen per header. Run a stress test once so it learns real top speeds.
data_description.rgb_w: Fan/RAM/strip/AIO-block RGB. GPU RGB is already included in the GPU reading.

usb.title: USB devices
usb.description:
Estimated draw per connected USB device, in watts. Set 0 to ignore a device.

{devices}

monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.description:
Power at 100% brightness for each monitor (W, at the wall). Estimate = max × (0.4 + 0.6 × brightness). Defaults come from the panel size.

{monitors}
